'''Nak Farool''' was the [[Special Assistant]] to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nile Owen]]. He organized the abduction of [[Crying Dawn Singer]] supposedly to help Owen gain the support of the [[Shashay]] [[Species/Legends|species]]; however, Farool was really conspiring to depose Owen and replace him with his brother [[Braig Farool]]. Once the plan had begun, Owen discovered Nak Farool's treachery and [[Death/Legends|executed]] him.
